_note: Release contract (T0.6). release.yml publishes `release.version` once: when CI is green on main and the tag v<version> does not exist yet, and only if app/build.gradle carries the same versionName/versionCode. null = nothing to release. Asset names end with the version (owner, 2026-10-12): `{version}` in `assets` is the app versionName; README links to the releases/latest page. `fully_tested: false` adds the 'not fully tested yet' line to the notes (INBOX #3: intermediate releases before the one full test pass).

release.notes_extra:
Every video a link can be played from should be downloadable (the owner's rule after Web Video Caster saved a Facebook reel VidChain's test called impossible). Tested on 33 real links on the Android 11 test phone: the actual share -> picker -> file flow, every saved file opened and decoded.

| Real links, shared on the test phone | before (2026-10-15, first run) | 1.2.1 |
|---|---|---|
| Saved as a playable video | 15 of 31 | 31 of 33 (TikTok and OK.ru do not answer on this network, from any device) |
| Pages without a known extractor (Reddit, Rumble, Tumblr, MDN, w3.org, videojs.com) | only the browser opened | saved by VidChain's own methods in about 2 minutes |
| Dailymotion, SoundCloud, TED, Bilibili, BitChute, Imgur | failed (yt-dlp from 2025 never updated) | saved (yt-dlp updates itself daily, the nightly build tries what the stable one cannot read) |
| vimeo.com page | asked to log in | 1080p |
| A DRM-protected (encrypted) video | saved as noise and called done | kept only as "a possible copy", with a message that it may not play |
| Facebook reel | picker 1.3 s | picker 0.9 s, 1080p in about 14 s |

Also: shared short links (t.co, bit.ly) no longer download twice, a re-shared link never answers from a download number the app has since reused, and removing a download from Finished never stops VidChain's search. Full list: CHANGELOG.md.

methods_per_abi._note: Fallback methods per ABI (Q8 = A: new natives on 64-bit only). CI and release.yml check every APK against this with tools/release/method_matrix.py; the universal APK carries each ABI's set.

method_natives._note: native libraries a method runs in lib/<abi>/ (S, W and H hand media streams to yt-dlp; ffmpeg merges and remuxes); methods not listed run on every ABI (Java/Kotlin or WebView)
